// ==UserScript==
// @name         TAOLAMBYPASS AUTO LINK4M
// @namespace    taolambypass.link4m
// @version      1.0.0
// @description  T\u1EF1 \u0111\u1ED9ng \u0111i\u1EC1n m\u00E3 code khi v\u1EC1 link4m (\u0111\u00E3 fix font + gi\u1EA3m lag)
// @author       TAOLAMBYPASS
// @match        *://*/*
// @grant        GM_setValue
// @grant        GM_getValue
// @grant        GM_deleteValue
// @grant        GM_addStyle
// @run-at       document-idle
// @noframes
// ==/UserScript==

(function () {
    'use strict';

    var HOST = location.hostname;
    var isLink4m = /(^|\.)link4m\.(net|org|com)$/i.test(HOST);
    var isGoogle = /(^|\.)google\./i.test(HOST);

    var CFG = { poll: 120, pollLag: 360, maxLoops: 30000, gk: 'mp_' };

    var S = {
        get: function(k, d) { try { var v = GM_getValue(CFG.gk + k, d); return v === undefined ? d : v; } catch (e) { return d; } },
        set: function(k, v) { try { GM_setValue(CFG.gk + k, v); } catch (e) {} },
        del: function(k) { try { GM_deleteValue(CFG.gk + k); } catch (e) {} },
        reset: function() {
            var keys = ['state','domain','link4m','code','targetUrl','returned','lastServerSec','lastPhase','lastTotal','lastClickTime','scrollOn','serverTotalSec','serverTotalSec2','waitReloadStart','filled','lagOn'];
            for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) S.del(keys[i]);
        }
    };

    // ============================================================
    // GI\u1EA2M LAG \u2014 cache + tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i
    // ============================================================
    var _cache = { fullText: '', fullTextT: 0, cd: null, cdT: 0, tick: 0 };
    function isLagOn() { return S.get('lagOn', '0') === '1'; }
    function getPoll() { return isLagOn() ? CFG.pollLag : CFG.poll; }
    function canHeavyScan(every) { return (_cache.tick % (every || 3)) === 0; }

    var DOMAINS = {
        getList: function() {
            try {
                var raw = S.get('savedDomains', '[]');
                return typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : (raw || []);
            } catch (e) { return []; }
        },
        save: function(domain) {
            var d = (domain || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\/.*$/, '');
            if (!d) return false;
            var list = DOMAINS.getList();
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (list[i].d === d) return false;
            list.unshift({ d: d, t: Date.now() });
            if (list.length > 30) list.length = 30;
            S.set('savedDomains', JSON.stringify(list));
            return true;
        },
        remove: function(d) {
            var list = DOMAINS.getList();
            var out = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (list[i].d !== d) out.push(list[i]);
            S.set('savedDomains', JSON.stringify(out));
        }
    };

    function log() {
        var args = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments);
        console.log.apply(console, ['%c\uD83D\uDC36 [TAOLAMBYPASS]', 'color:#ef233c;font-weight:700'].concat(args));
    }

    function sleep(ms) { return new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, ms); }); }
    function getState() { return S.get('state', 'idle'); }
    function setState(s) { S.set('state', s); log('\u2192 STATE:', s); refreshStatus(); }

    function isTargetPage() {
        var t = S.get('targetUrl');
        var curDomain = S.get('domain');
        var ch = HOST.replace(/^www\./, '');
        if (curDomain) {
            var cd = curDomain.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '').replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\/.*$/, '');
            if (ch.indexOf(cd) !== -1 || cd.indexOf(ch) !== -1) return true;
        }
        if (!t) return false;
        try {
            var th = new URL(t).hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');
            if (ch.indexOf(th) !== -1 || th.indexOf(ch) !== -1) return true;
        } catch (e) {}
        return false;
    }

    function isRealTargetPage() {
        return !isLink4m && !isGoogle && isTargetPage();
    }

    if (!isLink4m && !isGoogle && !isTargetPage()) return;

    var C = {
        bg1: '#fff5f5', bg2: '#ffe8e8', card: '#ffffff',
        pink: '#ef233c', pinkDark: '#b71c1c', pinkLight: '#ff8a8a',
        pinkSoft: '#ffe3e3', text: '#3d2c34', textSoft: '#8a6b77', border: '#ffc7c7'
    };

    // \u1EA2nh n\u00FAt tr\u00F2n khi thu nh\u1ECF menu (\u1EA3nh con ch\u00F3 b\u1EA1n g\u1EEDi, \u0111\u00E3 n\u00E9n base64)
    var DOG_B64 = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,';

    GM_addStyle(
        '#mp-root{position:fixed;top:10px;right:10px;z-index:2147483647;width:250px;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;font-size:11px;color:' + C.text + ';border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(160deg,' + C.bg1 + ' 0%,' + C.card + ' 60%,' + C.bg2 + ' 100%);box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(183,28,28,.28),0 0 0 1px ' + C.border + ';user-select:none;max-height:86vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;contain:layout paint;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}' +
        '#mp-root *{box-sizing:border-box}' +
        /* ===== THU NH\u1ECE \u2192 n\u00FAt tr\u00F2n \u1EA3nh ch\u00F3 ===== */
        '#mp-root.mp-min{width:64px !important;height:64px !important;border-radius:7px !important;max-height:none;padding:0;min-height:0;overflow:visible !important;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(201,24,74,.35)}' +
        '#mp-root.mp-min .mp-head{position:absolute;inset:0;padding:0;border-radius:6px;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(183,28,28,.12),rgba(183,28,28,.12)),url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");background-size:cover;background-position:center 38%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.45),0 6px 18px rgba(183,28,28,.35);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}' +
        '#mp-root.mp-min .mp-head:before{content:"";display:block;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}#mp-root.mp-min .mp-head:after{content:"+";position:absolute;bottom:3px;right:3px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:5px;background:#fff;color:#b71c1c;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}' +
        '#mp-root.mp-min .mp-brand,#mp-root.mp-min .mp-brand-txt,#mp-root.mp-min .mp-flower,#mp-root.mp-min .mp-body,#mp-root.mp-min .mp-foot,#mp-root.mp-min .mp-head-actions{display:none !important}' +
        '.mp-head{position:relative;padding:10px 12px;color:#fff;cursor:move;background:linear-gradient(135deg,' + C.pink + ' 0%,' + C.pinkDark + ' 100%);overflow:hidden;touch-action:none;flex-shrink:0}' +
        '.mp-head:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-30px;right:-30px;width:100px;height:100px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.35) 0%,transparent 65%);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}' +
        '.mp-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;position:relative;z-index:1}' +
        '.mp-flower{font-size:22px;line-height:1;filter:saturate(2.2) hue-rotate(335deg) brightness(.9)}' +
        '.mp-title-main{font-size:14px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.15px;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}' +
        '.mp-title-sub{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;opacity:.95;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}' +
        '.mp-head-actions{position:absolute;top:7px;right:7px;z-index:3;display:flex;gap:5px}' +
        '.mp-icon-btn{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1;padding:0;transition:background .15s}' +
        '.mp-icon-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}' +
        '.mp-body{padding:11px 13px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1}' +
        '.mp-body::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}' +
        '.mp-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:' + C.pinkLight + ';border-radius:3px}' +
        '.mp-status-card{background:#fff;border-radius:11px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:7px;border-left:3px solid ' + C.pink + ';box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(183,28,28,.10)}' +
        '.mp-status-label{font-size:8.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2.5px;color:' + C.textSoft + ';margin-bottom:4px}' +
        '.mp-status-value{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:' + C.pinkDark + ';line-height:1.45}' +
        '.mp-timer{display:none;text-align:center;padding:11px 0 9px;background:#fff;border-radius:11px;margin-bottom:9px}' +
        '.mp-timer.show{display:block}' +
        '.mp-timer-wrap{position:relative;width:84px;height:84px;margin:0 auto}' +
        '.mp-timer-wrap svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}' +
        '.mp-timer-track{fill:none;stroke:' + C.pinkSoft + ';stroke-width:5}' +
        '.mp-timer-prog{fill:none;stroke:url(#mpGrad);stroke-width:5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:188.5;stroke-dashoffset:0;transition:stroke-dashoffset .2s linear}' +
        '.mp-timer-num{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:23px;font-weight:900;color:' + C.pinkDark + ';font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}' +
        '.mp-timer-cap{margin-top:6px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;color:' + C.textSoft + '}' +
        '.mp-guide{display:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fffacd,#fff5b8);border:2px solid #ffd84d;border-radius:11px;padding:11px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:9px;font-size:10.5px;color:#8a6b77;line-height:1.55}' +
        '.mp-guide.show{display:block}' +
        '.mp-guide b{color:#b71c1c;font-size:12.5px}' +
        '.mp-code{display:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%,' + C.bg1 + ' 100%);border:2px dashed ' + C.pink + ';border-radius:11px;padding:11px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:9px}' +
        '.mp-code.show{display:block}' +
        '.mp-code-label{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2.5px;color:' + C.textSoft + ';margin-bottom:6px}' +
        '.mp-code-value{font-family:"JetBrains Mono","Consolas","Courier New",monospace;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:' + C.pinkDark + ';letter-spacing:2px;padding:9px 6px;background:#fff;border-radius:7px;margin-bottom:8px;word-break:break-all;user-select:text}' +
        '.mp-btn{width:100%;padding:8px;border:none;border-radius:6px;font-weight:800;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.3px;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,' + C.pink + ' 0%,' + C.pinkDark + ' 100%);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(183,28,28,.32);font-family:inherit;transition:transform .1s,filter .15s}' +
        '.mp-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}' +
        '.mp-btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}' +
        '.mp-btn.gray{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b8b8b8,#8a8a8a)}' +
        '.mp-btn.blue{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5aa7e8,#2b7fc4)}' +
        '.mp-btn.green{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#52c41a,#2f9e0a)}' +
        '.mp-btn.orange{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffb84d,#e88b00)}' +
        '.mp-btn.red{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff5a5a,#b71c1c)}' +
        '.mp-btn.purple{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9b6bff,#6a3bd4)}' +
        '.mp-btn-row{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-bottom:8px}' +
        '.mp-btn-row .mp-btn{flex:1}' +
        '.mp-log{max-height:95px;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px 10px;font-size:9.5px;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;line-height:1.5;color:' + C.textSoft + ';background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:7px;border:1px solid ' + C.pinkSoft + '}' +
        '.mp-log::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}' +
        '.mp-log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:' + C.pinkLight + ';border-radius:3px}' +
        '.mp-log div{padding:1.5px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,179,198,.35)}' +
        '.mp-foot{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px;color:#fff;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,' + C.pink + ' 0%,' + C.pinkDark + ' 100%);flex-shrink:0}' +
        '.mp-note{font-size:9.5px;color:' + C.textSoft + ';text-align:center;padding:6px;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:7px;background:' + C.pinkSoft + ';border-radius:7px;line-height:1.4}' +
        '#mp-fab{position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;z-index:2147483647;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef233c,#b71c1c);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(183,28,28,.42)}' +
        '.mp-section{background:#fff;border-radius:11px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:7px;box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(183,28,28,.08)}' +
        '.mp-section-title{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;color:' + C.pinkDark + ';margin-bottom:7px}' +
        '.mp-input{width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:1.5px solid ' + C.pinkLight + ';border-radius:7px;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;color:' + C.text + ';background:#fff;outline:none;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}' +
        '.mp-input:focus{border-color:' + C.pink + ';box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(239,35,60,.14)}' +
        '.mp-input::placeholder{color:#c9a4b3}' +
        '.mp-domain-list{max-height:105px;overflow-y:auto;margin-top:7px;border-radius:7px;background:' + C.bg1 + ';padding:4px}' +
        '.mp-domain-item{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-size:10.5px;cursor:pointer}' +
        '.mp-domain-item:hover{background:#fff}' +
        '.mp-domain-item .d-name{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600}' +
        '.mp-domain-item .d-use{padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:' + C.pink + ';color:#fff;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:800;border:none;cursor:pointer;margin-left:5px}' +
        '.mp-domain-item .d-del{padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;background:#ff5a5a;color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;border:none;cursor:pointer;margin-left:4px}' +
        '.mp-device{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px}' +
        '.mp-device-btn{flex:1;border:1px solid #ef233c;background:#fff;color:#b71c1c;border-radius:7px;padding:7px 5px;font-family:inherit;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}' +
        '.mp-device-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef233c,#b71c1c);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 9px rgba(183,28,28,.22)}' +
        '#mp-root.mp-desktop{width:320px;font-size:11.5px}' +
        '#mp-root.mp-desktop .mp-body{padding:12px 14px}' +
        '#mp-root.mp-desktop .mp-log{max-height:130px;font-size:10px}' +
        '@media (max-width:600px){#mp-root{max-width:calc(100vw - 14px);right:7px;top:7px}.mp-device-btn{font-size:8.5px}}' +
        '.mp-empty{text-align:center;color:' + C.textSoft + ';font-size:9.5px;padding:11px;font-style:italic}'
    );

    var UI = {};
    var loopRunning = false;
    var scrollRAF = null;
    var cachedBtn = null;
    var cachedBtnTime = 0;

    // ===== Gom log UI th\u00E0nh batch \u0111\u1EC3 gi\u1EA3m reflow =====
    var logBuf = [];
    var logFlushTimer = null;
    function scheduleLogFlush() {
        if (logFlushTimer) return;
        logFlushTimer = setTimeout(function () {
            logFlushTimer = null;
            if (!UI.log || !logBuf.length) { logBuf.length = 0; return; }
            var minimized = UI.root && UI.root.classList.contains('mp-min');
            var closed = UI.root && UI.root.style.display === 'none';
            if (minimized || closed) { logBuf.length = 0; return; } // \u0111ang thu nh\u1ECF/\u0111\u00F3ng \u2192 b\u1ECF qua, \u0111\u1EE1 v\u1EBD DOM
            var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
            for (var i = 0; i < logBuf.length; i++) {
                var d = document.createElement('div');
                d.textContent = '\u203A ' + logBuf[i];
                frag.appendChild(d);
            }
            logBuf.length = 0;
            UI.log.appendChild(frag);
            while (UI.log.children.length > 50) UI.log.removeChild(UI.log.firstChild);
            UI.log.scrollTop = UI.log.scrollHeight;
        }, isLagOn() ? 450 : 220);
    }

    var scrollState = {
        active: false,
        originY: 0,
        offset: 0,
        dir: 1,
        maxOffset: 50,
        step: 0.4,
        lastTime: 0,
        pauseUntil: 0
    };

    function buildPanel() {
        var old = document.getElementById('mp-root');
        if (old) old.remove();
        var root = document.createElement('div');
        root.id = 'mp-root';
        root.innerHTML =
            '<div class="mp-head" id="mp-head">' +
                '<div class="mp-head-actions">' +
                    '<button class="mp-icon-btn" id="mp-min">\u2212</button>' +
                    '<button class="mp-icon-btn" id="mp-close">\u00D7</button>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="mp-brand">' +
                    '<div class="mp-flower">\uD83D\uDC36</div>' +
                    '<div class="mp-brand-txt">' +
                        '<div class="mp-title-main">TAOLAMBYPASS \uD83C\uDDFB\uD83C\uDDF3</div>' +
                        '<div class="mp-title-sub">AUTO LINK4M v1</div>' +
                    '</div>' +
                '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="mp-body">' +
                '<div class="mp-note" id="mp-note">\uD83D\uDC36 TAOLAMBYPASS \u2022 S\u1EB4N S\u00C0NG</div>' +
                '<div class="mp-status-card">' +
                    '<div class="mp-status-label">TR\u1EA0NG TH\u00C1I</div>' +
                    '<div class="mp-status-value" id="mp-status">S\u1EB5n s\u00E0ng</div>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="mp-section" style="padding:7px 8px">' +
                    '<div class="mp-section-title">\u2699\uFE0F GIAO DI\u1EC6N THI\u1EBET B\u1ECA</div>' +
                    '<div class="mp-device" id="mp-device">' +
                        '<button class="mp-device-btn" id="mp-device-phone">\uD83D\uDCF1 \u0110I\u1EC6N THO\u1EA0I</button>' +
                        '<button class="mp-device-btn" id="mp-device-pc">\uD83D\uDDA5\uFE0F M\u00C1Y T\u00CDNH</button>' +
                    '</div>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="mp-section">' +
                    '<div class="mp-section-title">\uD83D\uDC36 DOMAIN \u0110\u00CDCH</div>' +
                    '<input class="mp-input" id="mp-domain-input" type="text" placeholder="vd: anoor.co" />' +
                    '<div class="mp-btn-row" style="margin-top:7px;margin-bottom:0">' +
                        '<button class="mp-btn blue" id="mp-save-domain">\uD83D\uDCBE L\u01AFU</button>' +
                        '<button class="mp-btn green" id="mp-start">\uD83D\uDC36 B\u1EAET \u0110\u1EA6U</button>' +
                    '</div>' +
                    '<div class="mp-domain-list" id="mp-domain-list"></div>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="mp-btn-row">' +
                    '<button class="mp-btn orange" id="mp-scroll-toggle" style="font-size:10.5px">\uD83D\uDD04 L\u01AF\u1EE2T NH\u1EB8</button>' +
                    '<button class="mp-btn purple" id="mp-lag-toggle" style="font-size:10.5px">\uD83D\uDE80 GI\u1EA2M LAG</button>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="mp-timer" id="mp-timer">' +
                    '<div class="mp-timer-wrap">' +
                        '<svg viewBox="0 0 60 60"><defs><linearGradient id="mpGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ef233c"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b71c1c"/></linearGradient></defs><circle class="mp-timer-track" cx="30" cy="30" r="26"/><circle class="mp-timer-prog" id="mp-timer-prog" cx="30" cy="30" r="26"/></svg>' +
                        '<div class="mp-timer-num" id="mp-timer-num">0</div>' +
                    '</div>' +
                    '<div class="mp-timer-cap" id="mp-timer-cap">\u0110ANG CH\u1EDC M\u00C3</div>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="mp-guide" id="mp-guide"></div>' +
                '<div class="mp-code" id="mp-code">' +
                    '<div class="mp-code-label">\uD83D\uDC36 M\u00C3 X\u00C1C NH\u1EACN \uD83D\uDC36</div>' +
                    '<div class="mp-code-value" id="mp-code-value">----</div>' +
                    '<button class="mp-btn" id="mp-copy">\uD83D\uDCCB SAO CH\u00C9P M\u00C3</button>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div id="mp-actions"></div>' +
                '<div class="mp-log" id="mp-log"></div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="mp-foot"><span>\uD83D\uDC36</span><span>\u00A9 TAOLAMBYPASS</span><span>\uD83D\uDC36</span></div>';
        document.body.appendChild(root);

        UI = {
            root: root, head: root.querySelector('#mp-head'),
            note: root.querySelector('#mp-note'), status: root.querySelector('#mp-status'),
            timer: root.querySelector('#mp-timer'), timerNum: root.querySelector('#mp-timer-num'),
            timerProg: root.querySelector('#mp-timer-prog'), timerCap: root.querySelector('#mp-timer-cap'),
            guide: root.querySelector('#mp-guide'), code: root.querySelector('#mp-code'),
            codeVal: root.querySelector('#mp-code-value'), copy: root.querySelector('#mp-copy'),
            actions: root.querySelector('#mp-actions'), log: root.querySelector('#mp-log'),
            minBtn: root.querySelector('#mp-min'), closeBtn: root.querySelector('#mp-close'),
            domainInput: root.querySelector('#mp-domain-input'),
            saveBtn: root.querySelector('#mp-save-domain'),
            startBtn: root.querySelector('#mp-start'), domainList: root.querySelector('#mp-domain-list'),
            scrollToggleBtn: root.querySelector('#mp-scroll-toggle'),
            lagToggleBtn: root.querySelector('#mp-lag-toggle'),
            devicePhone: root.querySelector('#mp-device-phone'), devicePc: root.querySelector('#mp-device-pc')
        };

        function applyDeviceMode(mode) {
            mode = mode === 'pc' ? 'pc' : 'phone';
            S.set('deviceMode', mode);
            UI.root.classList.toggle('mp-desktop', mode === 'pc');
            if (UI.devicePhone) UI.devicePhone.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'phone');
            if (UI.devicePc) UI.devicePc.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'pc');
        }
        UI.devicePhone.onclick = function(){ applyDeviceMode('phone'); };
        UI.devicePc.onclick = function(){ applyDeviceMode('pc'); };
        applyDeviceMode(S.get('deviceMode', 'phone'));

        UI.scrollToggleBtn.onclick = function() {
            if (S.get('scrollOn', '0') === '1') stopAutoScroll(); else startAutoScroll();
        };

        UI.lagToggleBtn.onclick = function() {
            var on = isLagOn();
            S.set('lagOn', on ? '0' : '1');
            updateLagBtn();
            log(on ? '\uD83D\uDC22 T\u1EAET gi\u1EA3m lag (ch\u1EA1y m\u01B0\u1EE3t g\u1ED1c)' : '\uD83D\uDE80 B\u1EACT gi\u1EA3m lag \u2014 qu\u00E9t nh\u1EB9 h\u01A1n, \u0111\u1EE1 gi\u1EADt');
        };
        updateLagBtn();

        UI.copy.onclick = function() {
            var c = UI.codeVal.textContent;
            if (!c || c === '----') return;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(c).then(function(){
                UI.copy.textContent = '\u2705 \u0110\u00C3 SAO CH\u00C9P!';
                setTimeout(function(){ UI.copy.textContent = '\uD83D\uDCCB SAO CH\u00C9P M\u00C3'; }, 1500);
            });
        };

        UI.saveBtn.onclick = function() {
            var v = UI.domainInput.value.trim();
            if (!v) { UI.domainInput.focus(); return; }
            var ok = DOMAINS.save(v);
            UI.saveBtn.textContent = ok ? '\u2705 \u0110\u00C3 L\u01AFU' : '\u26A0\uFE0F \u0110\u00C3 C\u00D3';
            setTimeout(function(){ UI.saveBtn.textContent = '\uD83D\uDCBE L\u01AFU'; }, 1200);
            renderDomainList();
        };

        UI.startBtn.onclick = function() {
            var v = UI.domainInput.value.trim();
            if (!v) { UI.status.textContent = '\u26A0\uFE0F Nh\u1EADp domain \u0111\u00EDch tr\u01B0\u1EDBc!'; UI.domainInput.focus(); return; }
            var domain = v.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\/.*$/, '').trim();
            var googleUrl = 'https://www.google.com/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(domain);
            log('\uD83C\uDF10 M\u1EDF Google:', googleUrl);
            var newTab = window.open(googleUrl, '_blank');

            S.set('domain', domain);
            S.set('link4m', location.href);
            S.del('returned'); S.del('code'); S.del('targetUrl');
            S.del('lastServerSec'); S.del('lastPhase'); S.del('lastTotal'); S.del('lastClickTime');
            S.del('serverTotalSec'); S.del('serverTotalSec2'); S.del('waitReloadStart'); S.del('filled');
            S.set('state', 'click-google');
            refreshStatus();

            var cont = findContinueBtn();
            if (cont) cont.click();

            DOMAINS.save(domain);
            renderDomainList();

            UI.status.textContent = newTab ? '\uD83D\uDD0D \u0110\u00C3 m\u1EDF tab Google' : '\u26A0\uFE0F Cho ph\u00E9p popup!';
        };

        UI.domainInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') UI.startBtn.click();
        });

        var orig = console.log;
        console.log = function() {
            orig.apply(console, arguments);
            if (!UI.log) return;
            var a = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments);
            var line = a.map(function(x){ return typeof x === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(x) : String(x); }).join(' ');
            logBuf.push(line);
            scheduleLogFlush();
        };

        UI.minBtn.onclick = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); toggleMin(); };
        UI.closeBtn.onclick = function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            UI.root.style.display = 'none';
            var fab = document.getElementById('mp-fab');
            if (!fab) {
                fab = document.createElement('div');
                fab.id = 'mp-fab'; fab.innerHTML = '\uD83D\uDC36';
                fab.onclick = function() { UI.root.style.display = ''; fab.remove(); };
                document.body.appendChild(fab);
            }
        };

        if (S.get('min') === '1') { UI.root.classList.add('mp-min'); UI.minBtn.textContent = '+'; }
        var pos = S.get('pos');
        if (pos && typeof pos === 'object') {
            UI.root.style.left = pos.x + 'px'; UI.root.style.top = pos.y + 'px'; UI.root.style.right = 'auto';
        }
        enableDrag();

        var cur = S.get('domain');
        if (cur) UI.domainInput.value = cur;

        if (S.get('scrollOn', '0') === '1') setTimeout(function() { startAutoScroll(); }, 500);
        renderDomainList();
    }

    function updateLagBtn() {
        if (!UI.lagToggleBtn) return;
        if (isLagOn()) {
            UI.lagToggleBtn.textContent = '\u2705 \u0110ANG GI\u1EA2M LAG';
            UI.lagToggleBtn.className = 'mp-btn green';
        } else {
            UI.lagToggleBtn.textContent = '\uD83D\uDE80 GI\u1EA2M LAG';
            UI.lagToggleBtn.className = 'mp-btn purple';
        }
    }

    function findL4MFast() {
        if (cachedBtn && Date.now() - cachedBtnTime < 1500) {
            if (document.contains(cachedBtn) && cachedBtn.offsetParent !== null) return cachedBtn;
        }
        var imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img');
        for (var i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
            var img = imgs[i];
            if (img.closest('#mp-root') || img.closest('#mp-fab')) continue;
            var src = (img.src || '').toLowerCase();
            var alt = (img.alt || '').toLowerCase();
            if (src.indexOf('l4m') === -1 && src.indexOf('layma') === -1 && src.indexOf('lay-ma') === -1 &&
                alt.indexOf('l4m') === -1 && alt.indexOf('l\u1EA5y') === -1) continue;
            var p = img.parentElement; var depth = 0; var best = null;
            while (p && depth < 6) {
                if (p.closest('#mp-root') || p.closest('#mp-fab')) { p = null; break; }
                if (p.offsetParent !== null) {
                    var pt = (p.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                    if (pt.length >= 3 && pt.length <= 100 && /l\u1EA5y\s*m\u00E3|lay\s*ma/i.test(pt)) best = p;
                }
                p = p.parentElement; depth++;
            }
            if (best) { cachedBtn = best; cachedBtnTime = Date.now(); return best; }
            if (img.parentElement && img.parentElement.offsetParent !== null) {
                cachedBtn = img.parentElement; cachedBtnTime = Date.now(); return img.parentElement;
            }
        }
        var q = document.querySelectorAll('a, button, [role="button"], [onclick], [onmousedown], [onmouseup], [ontouchstart]');
        for (var j = 0; j < q.length; j++) {
            var el = q[j];
            if (el.closest('#mp-root') || el.closest('#mp-fab')) continue;
            if (el.offsetParent === null) continue;
            var t = (el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            if (t.length < 3 || t.length > 100) continue;
            if (/test|debug|ki\u1EC3m tra|reset|sao ch\u00E9p|b\u1EADt l\u01B0\u1EDBt|t\u1EAFt l\u01B0\u1EDBt|qu\u00E9t/i.test(t)) continue;
            if (!/l\u1EA5y\s*m\u00E3|lay\s*ma|get\s*code/i.test(t)) continue;
            var inner = (el.innerHTML || '').toLowerCase();
            if (/l4m|lay-?ma/i.test(inner) || el.querySelector('img')) {
                cachedBtn = el; cachedBtnTime = Date.now(); return el;
            }
        }
        // V\u00F2ng qu\u00E9t n\u1EB7ng nh\u1EA5t (getComputedStyle) \u2014 ch\u1EC9 ch\u1EA1y c\u00E1ch tick \u0111\u1EC3 gi\u1EA3m lag
        if (!canHeavyScan(isLagOn() ? 4 : 2)) { cachedBtn = null; return null; }
        var all = document.querySelectorAll('div, span');
        for (var k = 0; k < all.length; k++) {
            var e2 = all[k];
            if (e2.closest('#mp-root') || e2.closest('#mp-fab')) continue;
            if (e2.offsetParent === null) continue;
            var t2 = (e2.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            if (t2.length > 100 || t2.length < 3) continue;
            if (/test|debug|ki\u1EC3m tra|reset|sao ch\u00E9p|b\u1EADt l\u01B0\u1EDBt|t\u1EAFt l\u01B0\u1EDBt|qu\u00E9t/i.test(t2)) continue;
            if (!/l\u1EA5y\s*m\u00E3|lay\s*ma/i.test(t2)) continue;
            var inner2 = (e2.innerHTML || '').toLowerCase();
            var hasL4M = /l4m|lay-?ma/i.test(inner2);
            var hasImg = e2.querySelector('img') !== null;
            try {
                var st = window.getComputedStyle(e2);
                var bg = st.backgroundColor || '';
                var bgImg = st.backgroundImage || '';
                var m = bg.match(/rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)/);
                var isRed = false;
                if (m) {
                    var R = parseInt(m[1], 10), G = parseInt(m[2], 10), B = parseInt(m[3], 10);
                    if (R > 180 && G < 100 && B < 100) isRed = true;
                }
                if (/gradient/i.test(bgImg) && /rgb\((2[0-5]\d|1[89]\d)/i.test(bgImg)) isRed = true;
                if (isRed && (hasL4M || hasImg)) { cachedBtn = e2; cachedBtnTime = Date.now(); return e2; }
                if (hasL4M && hasImg) { cachedBtn = e2; cachedBtnTime = Date.now(); return e2; }
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        cachedBtn = null;
        return null;
    }

    function findL4MInIframe() {
        var iframes = document.querySelectorAll('iframe');
        for (var i = 0; i < iframes.length; i++) {
            var ifr = iframes[i];
            var src = (ifr.src || '').toLowerCase();
            if (src.indexOf('website-analytics') === -1 && src.indexOf('get_quest') === -1 && src.indexOf('l4m') === -1 && src.indexOf('link4m') === -1) continue;
            try {
                var cdoc = ifr.contentDocument || ifr.contentWindow.document;
                if (cdoc) {
                    var inner = cdoc.querySelectorAll('a, button, div, span');
                    for (var j = 0; j < inner.length; j++) {
                        var el = inner[j];
                        var t = (el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                        if (/l\u1EA5y\s*m\u00E3/i.test(t) && t.length < 80) return { el: el, type: 'iframe-inner' };
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) { return { el: ifr, type: 'iframe-outer' }; }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function findL4MByPoint() {
        var w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight;
        var step = 60;
        for (var y = 40; y < h - 40; y += step) {
            for (var x = 20; x < w - 20; x += step) {
                try {
                    var els = document.elementsFromPoint(x, y);
                    for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
                        var el = els[i];
                        if (el.closest('#mp-root') || el.closest('#mp-fab')) continue;
                        var t = (el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                        if (t.length < 3 || t.length > 100) continue;
                        if (!/l\u1EA5y\s*m\u00E3|lay\s*ma/i.test(t)) continue;
                        if (/test|debug|ki\u1EC3m tra|reset|sao ch\u00E9p|b\u1EADt l\u01B0\u1EDBt|t\u1EAFt l\u01B0\u1EDBt|qu\u00E9t/i.test(t)) continue;
                        return el;
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Click nút Link4M: native click trước, MouseEvent chỉ là fallback.
     * Bản cũ phát nhiều click/pointer/touch liên tiếp -> dễ double-trigger + lag.
     */
    function clickL4M(el, type) {
        if (!el) return;
        try { el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'center' }); } catch (e) {}

        setTimeout(function () {
            var clicked = false;
            try {
                el.focus();
                el.click();
                clicked = true;
            } catch (e) {}

            if (!clicked) {
                try {
                    var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                    el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {
                        bubbles: true,
                        cancelable: true,
                        clientX: r.left + r.width / 2,
                        clientY: r.top + r.height / 2
                    }));
                    clicked = true;
                } catch (e2) {}
            }

            // iframe ngoài: thử phần tử đang nằm tại tâm, chỉ một lần.
            if (!clicked && type === 'iframe-outer') {
                try {
                    var r2 = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                    var topEl = document.elementFromPoint(r2.left + r2.width / 2, r2.top + r2.height / 2);
                    if (topEl && !topEl.closest('#mp-root')) topEl.click();
                } catch (e3) {}
            }

            log((clicked ? '✓' : '⚠') + ' Click nút L4M (' + (type || 'normal') + ')');
        }, 120);
    }

    function startAutoScroll() {
        if (scrollState.active) return;
        S.set('scrollOn', '1');
        if (UI.scrollToggleBtn) { UI.scrollToggleBtn.textContent = '\uD83D\uDED1 T\u1EAET L\u01AF\u1EE2T'; UI.scrollToggleBtn.className = 'mp-btn red'; }
        scrollState.active = true;
        scrollState.originY = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0;
        scrollState.offset = 0;
        scrollState.dir = 1;
        scrollState.lastTime = performance.now();
        scrollState.pauseUntil = 0;
        log('\uD83D\uDD04 B\u1EACT L\u01AF\u1EE2T M\u1EC0M T\u1EA0I Y=' + Math.round(scrollState.originY));
        var step = function(now) {
            if (!scrollState.active) return;
            var dt = now - scrollState.lastTime;
            scrollState.lastTime = now;
            if (now < scrollState.pauseUntil) {
                scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step);
                return;
            }
            var move = scrollState.step * (dt / 16);
            scrollState.offset += scrollState.dir * move;
            if (scrollState.offset >= scrollState.maxOffset) {
                scrollState.dir = -1;
                scrollState.pauseUntil = now + 400;
            } else if (scrollState.offset <= -scrollState.maxOffset) {
                scrollState.dir = 1;
                scrollState.pauseUntil = now + 400;
            }
            try { window.scrollTo(0, Math.round(scrollState.originY + scrollState.offset)); } catch (e) {}
            scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step);
        };
        scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }

    function stopAutoScroll() {
        scrollState.active = false;
        if (scrollRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(scrollRAF); scrollRAF = null; }
        S.set('scrollOn', '0');
        if (UI.scrollToggleBtn) { UI.scrollToggleBtn.textContent = '\uD83D\uDD04 L\u01AF\u1EE2T NH\u1EB8'; UI.scrollToggleBtn.className = 'mp-btn orange'; }
        log('\uD83D\uDED1 T\u1EAET L\u01AF\u1EE2T');
    }

    function renderDomainList() {
        if (!UI.domainList) return;
        var list = DOMAINS.getList();
        UI.domainList.innerHTML = '';
        if (!list.length) { UI.domainList.innerHTML = '<div class="mp-empty">Ch\u01B0a c\u00F3 domain n\u00E0o</div>'; return; }
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            (function(item) {
                var row = document.createElement('div');
                row.className = 'mp-domain-item';
                var name = document.createElement('div');
                name.className = 'd-name'; name.textContent = item.d;
                var useBtn = document.createElement('button');
                useBtn.className = 'd-use'; useBtn.textContent = 'D\u00D9NG';
                useBtn.onclick = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); UI.domainInput.value = item.d; };
                var delBtn = document.createElement('button');
                delBtn.className = 'd-del'; delBtn.textContent = '\u00D7';
                delBtn.onclick = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); DOMAINS.remove(item.d); renderDomainList(); };
                row.appendChild(name); row.appendChild(useBtn); row.appendChild(delBtn);
                row.onclick = function() { UI.domainInput.value = item.d; };
                UI.domainList.appendChild(row);
            })(list[i]);
        }
    }

    function toggleMin() {
        if (!UI.root) return;
        var m = UI.root.classList.toggle('mp-min');
        UI.minBtn.textContent = m ? '+' : '\u2212';
        S.set('min', m ? '1' : '0');
        if (!m) scheduleLogFlush(); // m\u1EDF l\u1EA1i \u2192 flush log \u0111\u00E3 gom
    }

    function enableDrag() {
        var h = UI.head; if (!h) return;
        var dg = false, moved = false, sx = 0, sy = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0;
        var dn = function(e) {
            if (e.target.closest('.mp-icon-btn')) return;

            // Khi menu đã thu nhỏ: ảnh mặt chó vẫn là vùng kéo.
            // Chạm nhẹ không di chuyển -> mở menu; kéo -> di chuyển ảnh.
            var p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
            dg = true;
            moved = false;
            sx = p.clientX; sy = p.clientY;

            var r = UI.root.getBoundingClientRect();
            ox = r.left; oy = r.top;
            UI.root.style.left = ox + 'px';
            UI.root.style.top = oy + 'px';
            UI.root.style.right = 'auto';

            document.addEventListener('mousemove', mv, { passive: false });
            document.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
            document.addEventListener('touchmove', mv, { passive: false });
            document.addEventListener('touchend', up);
            if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
        };

        var mv = function(e) {
            if (!dg) return;
            var p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
            var dx = p.clientX - sx, dy = p.clientY - sy;

            // Chỉ coi là kéo sau khi vượt ngưỡng vài pixel để tránh
            // chạm vào ảnh bị tính thành kéo ngoài ý muốn.
            if (!moved && Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 6) return;
            moved = true;

            var nx = ox + dx, ny = oy + dy;
            nx = Math.max(0, Math.min(nx, window.innerWidth - UI.root.offsetWidth));
            ny = Math.max(0, Math.min(ny, window.innerHeight - UI.root.offsetHeight));
            UI.root.style.left = nx + 'px';
            UI.root.style.top = ny + 'px';

            if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
        };

        var up = function() {
            if (!dg) return;
            dg = false;

            var r = UI.root.getBoundingClientRect();
            S.set('pos', { x: r.left, y: r.top });

            // Chỉ tap mới mở lại menu. Nếu đã kéo thì giữ nguyên vị trí.
            if (!moved && UI.root.classList.contains('mp-min')) {
                toggleMin();
            }

            document.removeEventListener('mousemove', mv);
            document.removeEventListener('mouseup', up);
            document.removeEventListener('touchmove', mv);
            document.removeEventListener('touchend', up);
        };

        h.addEventListener('mousedown', dn);
        h.addEventListener('touchstart', dn, { passive: false });
    }

    function refreshStatus() {
        if (!UI.status) return;
        var map = {
            'idle': 'S\u1EB5n s\u00E0ng \u2014 nh\u1EADp domain + B\u1EAET \u0110\u1EA6U',
            'click-google': '\uD83D\uDDA5\uFE0F \u0110ang t\u00ECm + click k\u1EBFt qu\u1EA3 Google...',
            'scan-click1': '\uD83D\uDD0E \u0110ang s\u0103n + click n\u00FAt L4M...',
            'counting1': '\u23F3 \u0110ang \u0111\u1EBFm phase 1...',
            'wait-reload-text': '\uD83D\uDC40 Ch\u1EDD text reload...',
            'reloading': '\uD83D\uDD04 \u0110ang reload...',
            'scan-click2': '\uD83C\uDFAF \u0110ang s\u0103n + click n\u00FAt L4M l\u1EA7n 2...',
            'counting2': '\u23F3 \u0110ang \u0111\u1EBFm phase 2...',
            'got-code': '\u2705 \u0110\u00E3 c\u00F3 m\u00E3',
            'back-link4m': '\uD83C\uDFE0 \u0110ang v\u1EC1 link4m...',
            'filling': '\uD83D\uDCDD \u0110\u00E3 \u0111i\u1EC1n m\u00E3 \u2014 gi\u1EA3i captcha v\u00E0 nh\u1EA5n x\u00E1c nh\u1EADn',
            'done': '\uD83C\uDF89 HO\u00C0N T\u1EA4T!'
        };
        UI.status.textContent = map[getState()] || getState();
    }

    function showTimer(sec, max, label) {
        if (!UI.timer) return;
        // \u0110ang thu nh\u1ECF \u2192 b\u1ECF qua c\u1EADp nh\u1EADt \u0111\u1ED3 h\u1ECDa, \u0111\u1EE1 v\u1EBD l\u1EA1i
        if (UI.root.classList.contains('mp-min') || UI.root.style.display === 'none') return;
        UI.timer.classList.add('show');
        UI.timerNum.textContent = sec;
        UI.timerCap.textContent = label || '\u0110ANG CH\u1EDC M\u00C3';
        if (max > 0) {
            var C_ = 2 * Math.PI * 26;
            UI.timerProg.style.strokeDashoffset = C_ * (1 - (sec / max));
        }
    }
    function hideTimer() { if (UI.timer) UI.timer.classList.remove('show'); }
    function showGuide(html) { if (UI.guide) { UI.guide.innerHTML = html; UI.guide.classList.add('show'); } }
    function showCode(code) {
        if (!UI.code) return;
        UI.code.classList.add('show');
        UI.codeVal.textContent = code;
        try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code); log('\uD83D\uDCCB \u0110\u00E3 copy code:', code); } catch (e) {}
    }

    var CD_PATTERNS = [
        /vui l\u00F2ng ch\u1EDD\s*(\d+)\s*s?\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)\s*\)/i,
        /vui l\u00F2ng ch\u1EDD\s*(\d+)\s*gi\u00E2y\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)\s*\)/i,
        /ch\u1EDD\s*(\d+)\s*s\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)\s*\)/i,
        /ch\u1EDD\s*(\d+)\s*gi\u00E2y\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)\s*\)/i,
        /(\d+)\s*s\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)\s*\)/i,
        /vui l\u00F2ng ch\u1EDD\s*(\d+)\s*s\b/i,
        /vui l\u00F2ng ch\u1EDD\s*(\d+)\s*gi\u00E2y/i,
        /ch\u1EDD\s*(\d+)\s*s\b/i,
        /ch\u1EDD\s*(\d+)\s*gi\u00E2y/i,
        /c\u00F2n[:\s]*(\d+)\s*gi\u00E2y/i,
        /c\u00F2n[:\s]*(\d+)\s*s\b/i,
        /c\u00F2n[:\s]*(\d+)/i
    ];

    function parseCountdownText(text) {
        if (!text) return null;
        for (var p = 0; p < CD_PATTERNS.length; p++) {
            var m = text.match(CD_PATTERNS[p]);
            if (m) {
                var sec = parseInt(m[1], 10);
                var phase = m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 1;
                var total = m[3] ? parseInt(m[3], 10) : 2;
                if (!isNaN(sec) && sec >= 0 && sec <= 999) return { sec: sec, phase: phase, total: total, raw: m[0] };
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function readCountdownInDoc(doc) {
        if (!doc) return null;
        try { var bt = (doc.body && doc.body.textContent) || ''; var r1 = parseCountdownText(bt); if (r1) return r1; } catch (e) {}
        try {
            var sels = ['#timer','#countdown','#clock','.timer','.countdown','.clock','[id*="timer" i]','[id*="count" i]','[id*="clock" i]','[id*="wait" i]','[class*="timer" i]','[class*="count" i]','[class*="clock" i]','[class*="wait" i]'];
            for (var s = 0; s < sels.length; s++) {
                var els = doc.querySelectorAll(sels[s]);
                for (var e = 0; e < els.length; e++) {
                    var el = els[e];
                    if (el.closest && el.closest('#mp-root')) continue;
                    var t = (el.textContent || '').trim();
                    var r3 = parseCountdownText(t);
                    if (r3) return r3;
                    var num = t.match(/^(\d+)$/);
                    if (num) { var n = parseInt(num[1], 10); if (n >= 0 && n <= 999) return { sec: n, phase: 1, total: 2, raw: t }; }
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
            var walker = doc.createTreeWalker(doc.body || doc, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
            var node; var count = 0;
            while ((node = walker.nextNode()) && count < 5000) {
                count++;
                var text = (node.textContent || '').trim();
                if (!text || text.length < 3) continue;
                if (text.indexOf('ch\u1EDD') === -1 && text.indexOf('c\u00F2n') === -1 && text.indexOf('gi\u00E2y') === -1 && text.indexOf('s (') === -1 && text.indexOf('/') === -1) continue;
                var r4 = parseCountdownText(text);
                if (r4) return r4;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
            var iframes = doc.querySelectorAll('iframe');
            for (var f = 0; f < iframes.length; f++) {
                try { var cdoc = iframes[f].contentDocument || iframes[f].contentWindow.document; if (cdoc) { var r5 = readCountdownInDoc(cdoc); if (r5) return r5; } } catch (e) {}
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
            var allEls = doc.querySelectorAll('*');
            for (var k = 0; k < allEls.length && k < 2000; k++) {
                var sr = allEls[k].shadowRoot;
                if (sr) { try { var r6 = readCountdownInDoc(sr); if (r6) return r6; } catch (e) {} }
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    // Cache k\u1EBFt qu\u1EA3 \u0111\u1ECDc countdown \u0111\u1EC3 kh\u00F4ng qu\u00E9t l\u1EA1i DOM m\u1ED7i tick
    function readServerCountdown() {
        var now = Date.now();
        var ttl = isLagOn() ? 850 : 300;
        if (now - _cache.cdT < ttl) return _cache.cd;
        var r = readCountdownInDoc(document);
        _cache.cd = r; _cache.cdT = now;
        return r;
    }

    // D\u00F9ng textContent (kh\u00F4ng g\u00E2y reflow) + cache
    function getFullTextAllDocs() {
        var now = Date.now();
        var ttl = isLagOn() ? 900 : 350;
        if (now - _cache.fullTextT < ttl) return _cache.fullText;
        var all = '';
        try { all += (document.body.textContent || '') + ' '; } catch (e) {}
        try {
            var iframes = document.querySelectorAll('iframe');
            for (var i = 0; i < iframes.length; i++) {
                try {
                    var cdoc = iframes[i].contentDocument || iframes[i].contentWindow.document;
                    if (cdoc && cdoc.body) all += (cdoc.body.textContent || '') + ' ';
                } catch (e) {}
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        _cache.fullText = all; _cache.fullTextT = now;
        return all;
    }

    function removeVietnameseAccents(s) {
        return (s || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[\u0111\u0110]/g, 'd').toLowerCase();
    }

    function isAskClickLink() {
        var n = removeVietnameseAccents(getFullTextAllDocs());
        if (/(nhan|click|bam).{0,30}(link|duong dan).{0,30}(bat ki|bat ky|bat cu)/i.test(n)) return true;
        if (/(vui long|hay).{0,30}(nhan|click|bam).{0,30}(link|duong dan)/i.test(n)) return true;
        if (/nhan vao link bat ki/i.test(n)) return true;
        if (/click vao link bat ki/i.test(n)) return true;
        if (/vui long nhan vao link/i.test(n)) return true;
        if (/vui long click vao link/i.test(n)) return true;
        if (/luot xuong vi tri nay/i.test(n)) return true;
        if (/vi tri nay de lay ma/i.test(n)) return true;
        if (/de lay ma/i.test(n) && /(nhan|click|luot)/i.test(n)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    function extractCode() {
        var all = getFullTextAllDocs();
        var patterns = [
            /m\u00E3\s*km[:\s]+([A-Za-z0-9_\-]{4,32})/i,
            /m\u00E3\s*code[:\s]+([A-Za-z0-9_\-]{4,32})/i,
            /m\u00E3\s*x\u00E1c\s*nh\u1EADn[:\s]+([A-Za-z0-9_\-]{4,32})/i,
            /m\u00E3\s*th\u01B0\u1EDFng[:\s]+([A-Za-z0-9_\-]{4,32})/i
        ];
        for (var p = 0; p < patterns.length; p++) {
            var m = all.match(patterns[p]);
            if (m) {
                var c = m[1].trim();
                if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(c)) continue;
                if (/\.(com|net|org|me|vn|io|info)/i.test(c)) continue;
                if (c.length < 4 || c.length > 32) continue;
                return c;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function findGoogleResult(domain) {
        var kw = domain.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '');
        var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="http"]'));
        for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
            var a = links[i];
            var h = a.href.toLowerCase();
            if (/google\.|gstatic\.|googleusercontent\.|youtube\.|wikipedia\.|facebook\.|accounts\./i.test(h)) continue;
            if (h.indexOf(kw) !== -1) return a;
        }
        var selectors = ['#search a[href^="http"]', '#rso a[href^="http"]', '.g a[href^="http"]', 'a[href^="http"]'];
        for (var s = 0; s < selectors.length; s++) {
            var els = document.querySelectorAll(selectors[s]);
            for (var e = 0; e < els.length; e++) {
                var el = els[e];
                var href = el.href.toLowerCase();
                if (/google\.|gstatic\.|googleusercontent\.|youtube\.|wikipedia\.|facebook\.|accounts\.|policies\.|support\.|maps\./i.test(href)) continue;
                if (href.indexOf('http') !== 0) continue;
                if (href.length < 15) continue;
                return el;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function findContinueBtn() {
        var els = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('a, button'));
        for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
            var e = els[i];
            if (e.offsetParent === null || e.closest('#mp-root')) continue;
            if (/click v\u00E0o \u0111\u00E2y|ti\u1EBFp t\u1EE5c|continue/i.test((e.textContent || '').trim())) return e;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // T\u00CCM \u00D4 NH\u1EACP M\u00C3 TR\u00CAN LINK4M
    // ============================================================
    function findCodeInputOnLink4m() {
        var sels = [
            'input[name="code"]',
            'input#code',
            'input[placeholder*="Nh\u1EADp m\u00E3"]',
            'input[placeholder*="nh\u1EADp m\u00E3"]',
            'input[placeholder*="m\u00E3"]',
            'input[placeholder*="code"]',
            'input[type="text"]'
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < sels.length; i++) {
            var els = document.querySelectorAll(sels[i]);
            for (var j = 0; j < els.length; j++) {
                var el = els[j];
                if (el.closest('#mp-root')) continue;
                if (el.offsetParent === null) continue;
                // B\u1ECF qua \u00F4 t\u00ECm ki\u1EBFm Google
                if (el.name && /search|q|query/i.test(el.name)) continue;
                return el;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // T\u1EF0 \u0110\u1ED8NG \u0110I\u1EC0N M\u00C3 KHI V\u1EC0 LINK4M
    // ============================================================
    function handleLink4m() {
        var st = getState();
        var code = S.get('code');

        // ===== T\u1EF0 \u0110\u1ED8NG \u0110I\u1EC0N M\u00C3 =====
        if (code) {
            var filled = S.get('filled', '0') === '1';
            var inp = findCodeInputOnLink4m();

            if (inp && !filled) {
                log('\uD83D\uDCDD T\u1EF0 \u0110\u1ED8NG \u0110I\u1EC0N M\u00C3:', code);
                if (fillLink4mCode(inp, code)) {
                    S.set('filled', '1');
                    log('\u2713 ĐÃ ĐIỀN MÃ VÀO Ô NHẬP');
                    showCode(code);
                    showGuide('<b>🐶 ĐÃ ĐIỀN MÃ VÀO Ô 🐶</b><br>Mã: <b>' + code + '</b><br>Bước 1: Giải captcha reCAPTCHA<br>Bước 2: Nhấn <b>"Click vào đây để tiếp tục"</b>');
                    setState('filling');
                }
            } else if (inp && filled) {
                // \u0110\u00E3 \u0111i\u1EC1n r\u1ED3i \u2014 hi\u1EC3n th\u1ECB tr\u1EA1ng th\u00E1i ch\u1EDD user
                UI.status.textContent = '\uD83D\uDCDD \u0110\u00E3 \u0111i\u1EC1n m\u00E3 \u2014 gi\u1EA3i captcha v\u00E0 nh\u1EA5n x\u00E1c nh\u1EADn';
                showCode(code);
            } else if (!inp && !filled) {
                // Ch\u01B0a t\u00ECm th\u1EA5y \u00F4 nh\u1EADp m\u00E3 \u2014 th\u1EED l\u1EA1i m\u1ED7i tick
                UI.status.textContent = '\uD83D\uDCDD \u0110ang ch\u1EDD \u00F4 nh\u1EADp m\u00E3 xu\u1EA5t hi\u1EC7n...';
            }
        }

        if (st === 'idle') {
            UI.status.textContent = 'S\u1EB5n s\u00E0ng \u2014 nh\u1EADp domain + B\u1EAET \u0110\u1EA6U';
            return Promise.resolve();
        }
        return Promise.resolve();
    }

    function handleGoogle() {
        var st = getState();
        if (st !== 'click-google') return Promise.resolve();
        var domain = S.get('domain');
        if (!domain) return Promise.resolve();
        log('\uD83D\uDDA5\uFE0F Click Google si\u00EAu nhanh cho:', domain);

        return sleep(100).then(function() {
            var i = 0;
            var check = function() {
                if (i >= 80) {
                    log('\u26A0\uFE0F Kh\u00F4ng t\u00ECm th\u1EA5y link Google \u2192 m\u1EDF tr\u1EF1c ti\u1EBFp domain');
                    S.set('targetUrl', 'https://' + domain);
                    setState('scan-click1');
                    window.open('https://' + domain, '_blank');
                    return Promise.resolve();
                }
                var link = findGoogleResult(domain);
                if (link) {
                    log('\u2713 CLICK NGAY:', link.href);
                    S.set('targetUrl', link.href);
                    try { link.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'center' }); } catch (e) {}
                    try {
                        link.click();
                    } catch (e) {
                        try { link.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); } catch (e2) {}
                    }
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        log('\u2192 Chuy\u1EC3n state sang scan-click1');
                        setState('scan-click1');
                    }, 300);
                    return Promise.resolve();
                }
                i++;
                return sleep(50).then(check);
            };
            return check();
        });
    }

    // Helper: t\u00ECm n\u00FAt L4M theo th\u1EE9 t\u1EF1 nh\u1EB9 \u2192 n\u1EB7ng, kh\u00F4ng g\u1ECDi l\u1EB7p 2 l\u1EA7n
    function findAnyL4M(allowPoint) {
        var b = findL4MFast();
        if (b) return { el: b, type: 'normal' };
        var ifr = findL4MInIframe();
        if (ifr) return ifr;
        if (allowPoint && canHeavyScan(4)) {
            var p = findL4MByPoint();
            if (p) return { el: p, type: 'point' };
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // LINK4M FLOW — click → countdown → reload → click lần 2 → code
    // ============================================================
    function handleTarget() {
        var st = getState();

        if (isRealTargetPage() && st === 'click-google') {
            log('\u2192 \u0110ang \u1EDF trang \u0111\u00EDch, state click-google \u2192 chuy\u1EC3n scan-click1');
            setState('scan-click1');
            return Promise.resolve();
        }

        if (st === 'scan-click1' || st === 'scan-click2') {
            var found = findAnyL4M(true);
            var btnEl = found ? found.el : null;
            var btnType = found ? found.type : 'normal';
            if (btnEl) {
                var lastClick = parseInt(S.get('lastClickTime', '0'), 10);
                if (Date.now() - lastClick < 2500) return Promise.resolve();
                log('\u2713\u2713\u2713 T\u00CCM TH\u1EA4Y N\u00DAT L4M (' + btnType + ')! T\u1EF0 CLICK.');
                UI.status.textContent = '\u2713 \u0110\u00E3 th\u1EA5y n\u00FAt \u2014 \u0111ang click...';
                S.set('lastClickTime', Date.now().toString());
                clickL4M(btnEl, btnType);
                return sleep(2000).then(function() {
                    var sc = readServerCountdown();
                    if (sc) { S.set('lastServerSec', sc.sec.toString()); setState(st === 'scan-click1' ? 'counting1' : 'counting2'); }
                    else setState(st === 'scan-click1' ? 'counting1' : 'counting2');
                });
            }
            var sc0 = readServerCountdown();
            if (sc0) setState(st === 'scan-click1' ? 'counting1' : 'counting2');
            return Promise.resolve();
        }

        if (st === 'counting1') {
            var liveCode = extractCode();
            if (liveCode) { S.set('code', liveCode); showCode(liveCode); setState('got-code'); return Promise.resolve(); }
            var sc = readServerCountdown();
            if (!sc) {
                if (isAskClickLink()) {
                    log('\u2713 Th\u1EA5y text y\u00EAu c\u1EA7u click \u2192 chuy\u1EC3n sang ch\u1EDD reload');
                    hideTimer();
                    S.set('waitReloadStart', Date.now().toString());
                    setState('wait-reload-text');
                    return Promise.resolve();
                }
                var f2 = findAnyL4M(false);
                var btn2 = f2 ? f2.el : null;
                if (btn2) {
                    var lc = parseInt(S.get('lastClickTime', '0'), 10);
                    if (Date.now() - lc > 2500) {
                        S.set('lastClickTime', Date.now().toString());
                        clickL4M(btn2, 'normal');
                    }
                }
                return Promise.resolve();
            }

            var totalSec = parseInt(S.get('serverTotalSec', '0'), 10);
            if (sc.sec > totalSec) {
                totalSec = sc.sec;
                S.set('serverTotalSec', totalSec.toString());
                log('\uD83D\uDCCA M\u1ED1c g\u1ED1c phase 1 = ' + totalSec + 's');
            }
            if (totalSec === 0) {
                totalSec = sc.sec;
                S.set('serverTotalSec', totalSec.toString());
            }

            var phaseLabel = sc.phase + '/' + sc.total;
            showTimer(sc.sec, totalSec, 'CH\u1EDC ' + sc.sec + ' GI\u00C2Y (' + phaseLabel + ')');
            S.set('lastServerSec', sc.sec.toString());

            if (sc.sec === 0) {
                log('\u2192 Server v\u1EC1 0. Chuy\u1EC3n sang wait-reload-text');
                S.del('serverTotalSec');
                S.set('waitReloadStart', Date.now().toString());
                setState('wait-reload-text');
            }
            return Promise.resolve();
        }

        if (st === 'wait-reload-text') {
            var liveCode2 = extractCode();
            if (liveCode2) { S.set('code', liveCode2); showCode(liveCode2); setState('got-code'); return Promise.resolve(); }

            var waitStart = parseInt(S.get('waitReloadStart', '0'), 10);
            var elapsed = waitStart > 0 ? Date.now() - waitStart : 0;
            var askClick = isAskClickLink();
            var timeout = elapsed > 3000;

            var sc2 = readServerCountdown();
            if (sc2 && sc2.sec > 0 && !askClick && !timeout) {
                S.del('waitReloadStart');
                setState('counting1');
                return Promise.resolve();
            }

            if (askClick || timeout) {
                if (askClick) log('\u2713 TH\u1EA4Y TEXT "nh\u1EA5n v\u00E0o link b\u1EA5t k\u00EC" \u2192 RELOAD');
                if (timeout) log('\u23F1\uFE0F \u0110\u00E3 \u0111\u1EE3i 3s \u2192 RELOAD');
                showGuide('<b>\uD83D\uDD04 \u0110ANG RELOAD...</b>');
                S.del('waitReloadStart');
                return sleep(800).then(function() { hideTimer(); setState('reloading'); location.reload(); });
            }
            return Promise.resolve();
        }

        if (st === 'reloading') { setState('scan-click2'); return sleep(1000); }

        if (st === 'counting2') {
            var liveCode3 = extractCode();
            if (liveCode3) { S.set('code', liveCode3); showCode(liveCode3); setState('got-code'); return Promise.resolve(); }

            var sc4 = readServerCountdown();

            if (!sc4) {
                var f3 = findAnyL4M(false);
                var btn3 = f3 ? f3.el : null;
                if (btn3) {
                    var lc3 = parseInt(S.get('lastClickTime', '0'), 10);
                    if (Date.now() - lc3 > 2500) {
                        S.set('lastClickTime', Date.now().toString());
                        clickL4M(btn3, 'normal');
                        return Promise.resolve();
                    }
                }
                return Promise.resolve();
            }

            var totalSec2 = parseInt(S.get('serverTotalSec2', '0'), 10);
            if (sc4.sec > totalSec2) {
                totalSec2 = sc4.sec;
                S.set('serverTotalSec2', totalSec2.toString());
                log('\uD83D\uDCCA M\u1ED1c g\u1ED1c phase 2 = ' + totalSec2 + 's');
            }
            if (totalSec2 === 0) {
                totalSec2 = sc4.sec;
                S.set('serverTotalSec2', totalSec2.toString());
                log('\uD83D\uDCCA M\u1ED1c g\u1ED1c phase 2 = ' + totalSec2 + 's');
            }

            var phaseLabel2 = sc4.phase + '/' + sc4.total;
            showTimer(sc4.sec, totalSec2, 'CH\u1EDC ' + sc4.sec + ' GI\u00C2Y (' + phaseLabel2 + ')');
            S.set('lastServerSec', sc4.sec.toString());
            S.set('lastPhase', sc4.phase.toString());
            S.set('lastTotal', sc4.total.toString());

            if (sc4.sec === 0) {
                log('\u2192 Phase 2 server v\u1EC1 0, th\u1EED l\u1EA5y m\u00E3');
                S.del('serverTotalSec2');
                var f4 = findAnyL4M(false);
                var btn4 = f4 ? f4.el : null;
                if (btn4) {
                    S.set('lastClickTime', Date.now().toString());
                    clickL4M(btn4, 'normal');
                }
            }
            return Promise.resolve();
        }

        if (st === 'got-code' || st === 'back-link4m') {
            setState('back-link4m');
            showGuide('<b>\uD83C\uDFE0 \u0110ANG QUAY V\u1EC0 LINK4M...</b>');
            var l4 = S.get('link4m');
            if (l4) return sleep(2000).then(function() { location.href = l4; });
            return Promise.resolve();
        }
        return Promise.resolve();
    }

    // Vòng lặp nhẹ: mỗi tick chỉ chạy đúng handler của trang hiện tại.
    function loop() {
        if (loopRunning) return;
        loopRunning = true;
        log('\u25B6 V\u00F2ng l\u1EB7p (poll=' + getPoll() + 'ms' + (isLagOn() ? ', gi\u1EA3m lag b\u1EADt' : '') + ')');
        var i = 0;
        var tick = function() {
            if (i >= CFG.maxLoops) { loopRunning = false; return; }
            i++;
            _cache.tick++;
            var p;
            if (isGoogle) p = handleGoogle();
            else if (isRealTargetPage()) p = handleTarget();
            else if (isLink4m) p = handleLink4m();
            else p = Promise.resolve();
            p.catch(function(e){ log('L\u1ED7i:', e.message); }).then(function() {
                if (getState() === 'done') { loopRunning = false; return; }
                setTimeout(tick, getPoll());
            });
        };
        tick();
    }

    function addResetButton() {
        if (!UI.actions) return;
        if (UI.actions.querySelector('.mp-reset-wrap')) return;
        var wrap = document.createElement('div');
        wrap.className = 'mp-btn-row mp-reset-wrap';
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.className = 'mp-btn gray';
        b.textContent = '\uD83D\uDD04 RESET TOOL';
        b.onclick = function() {
            if (!confirm('Reset to\u00E0n b\u1ED9?')) return;
            stopAutoScroll();
            S.reset();
            location.reload();
        };
        wrap.appendChild(b);
        UI.actions.appendChild(wrap);
    }

    function boot() {
        buildPanel();
        var st = getState();
        log('Kh\u1EDFi \u0111\u1ED9ng | Host:', HOST, '| State:', st, '| isRealTarget:', isRealTargetPage(), '| Gi\u1EA3m lag:', isLagOn() ? 'B\u1EACT' : 'T\u1EAET');
        refreshStatus();
        addResetButton();

        if (S.get('code')) showCode(S.get('code'));

        if (isRealTargetPage() && st === 'click-google') {
            setState('scan-click1');
        }

        if (st && st !== 'idle' && st !== 'done') {
            loop();
        }

        if (UI.note) {
            if (isLink4m) UI.note.textContent = '\uD83D\uDC36 TAOLAMBYPASS \u2022 S\u1EB4N S\u00C0NG';
            else if (isGoogle) UI.note.textContent = '\uD83D\uDCA1 GOOGLE \u2014 tool t\u1EF1 click k\u1EBFt qu\u1EA3 \u0111\u1EA7u ti\u00EAn';
            else if (isRealTargetPage()) UI.note.textContent = '\uD83D\uDCA1 TRANG \u0110\u00CDCH \u2014 tool t\u1EF1 s\u0103n + click n\u00FAt L4M';
        }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    else boot();
})();
